away.summary: The Blackhawks (4-8-0) are projected to start Spencer Knight in goal. Patrick Kane faces Detroit for the first time since leaving the Red Wings after three seasons. Vlasic is a game-time decision due to illness, while Greene and Teravainen will switch lines.

home.summary: The Red Wings (5-4-3) are projected to start John Gibson, with Daniil Tarasov returning after missing three games with an undisclosed injury to serve as backup. Dylan Larkin will not play, and coach Todd McLellan said interim GM Shawn Horcoff will address Larkin's situation later Thursday. Detroit returns home after a four-game road trip through the Pacific Northwest and Western Canada.
